BattleSubject, BattleFill, BattleHole, Concentration state, and active Spell Effect facts

notes: Task 8 introduced no new durable Concentration or active-effect state fields.
Concentration remains the existing BattleCreatureState.concentration value.
Spell Effect cleanup remains the existing BattleCreatureState.activeEffects collection.
The endConcentration runtime command is a public reducer subject for resolving voluntary cleanup, not a stored ledger; stale subjects and unexpected fills are rejected.
